university.name: Queen's University Belfast
university.summary: A research-intensive university in Belfast with a dedicated international students section, a Pakistan country page and a Pakistan scholarships page. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate taught and research degrees, and pathway courses through its International Study Centre.

courses.title: Management
courses.overview: A one-year full time master's in management for graduates of any discipline, with core modules in digital marketing, operations and supply chains, finance for managers and analytics with artificial intelligence.
courses.academic_requirements: Normally a 2.2 Honours degree, or an equivalent qualification acceptable to the university, in any discipline.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with no component below 5.5, taken within the last 2 years, or an equivalent qualification. The university's comparable scores for this level are PTE Academic 64 (59 in each component) and Duolingo 110 (100 in each subscore).
courses.application_deadline_note: Apply ideally no later than 13 August 2027 for courses starting in late September; the university may close earlier if demand is high.
courses.notes: The course page also shows a GBP 10,000 discount for September 2027 entry; its terms were not found, so it is not listed as a scholarship. PTE and Duolingo figures come from the university's general English language page for the IELTS 6.0 category.

courses.title: Human Resource Management
courses.duration_text: 1 year full time (2 years part time also offered)
courses.overview: A one-year master's in human resource management from the business school, covering people strategy, resourcing and talent management, employment relations and human resources analytics.
courses.academic_requirements: Normally a 2.2 Honours degree or equivalent in any discipline. Applicants with relevant experience and a lower degree are considered case by case and may be asked for an interview, written work or an exam.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with no component below 5.5, taken within the last 2 years, or an equivalent qualification. The university's comparable scores for this level are PTE Academic 64 (59 in each component) and Duolingo 110 (100 in each subscore).
courses.application_deadline_note: Apply ideally no later than 13 August 2027 for courses starting in late September.
courses.notes: The fee is taken from the international fees page, which lists MSc Human Resource Management at GBP 27,800 for 2027/28; the course page fee table was not readable.

courses.title: Financial Analytics
courses.overview: A one-year master's combining finance theory with data and programming methods, with modules on asset pricing, financial data analytics, financial modelling in Python and artificial intelligence in trading.
courses.academic_requirements: Normally a 2.2 Honours degree or equivalent in a relevant quantitative subject such as finance, economics, mathematics or statistics. Other degrees may be considered case by case with 2:2-level performance in quantitative modules.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with no component below 5.5, taken within the last 2 years, or an equivalent qualification. The university's comparable scores for this level are PTE Academic 64 (59 in each component) and Duolingo 110 (100 in each subscore).
courses.application_deadline_note: Apply ideally no later than 13 August 2027 for courses starting in late September; the university may close earlier if oversubscribed.
courses.notes: The fee is taken from the international fees page, which lists MSc Financial Analytics at GBP 27,800 for 2027/28; the course page fee table was not readable.

courses.title: Data Analytics
courses.duration_text: 1 year full time (2 years part time also offered)
courses.overview: A one-year master's from the mathematics and physics school covering statistics, programming, data mining and machine learning, aimed at graduates in mathematics, statistics, computing or related subjects.
courses.academic_requirements: Normally a 2.2 Honours degree in mathematics, statistics, computer science, computer applications or a closely related discipline.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with no component below 5.5, taken within the last 2 years, or an equivalent qualification. The university's comparable scores for this level are PTE Academic 64 (59 in each component) and Duolingo 110 (100 in each subscore).
courses.application_deadline_note: The page gives 30 June as the closing date for September entry; later applications are considered only if places remain.
courses.notes: The course page states the fee without naming the year; it matches the 2027/28 laboratory-based postgraduate rate of GBP 29,000 on the international fees page.

courses.title: Software Development (AI)
courses.overview: A one-year conversion-style master's for graduates from non-computing disciplines, covering programming, software engineering, web development and data-driven systems with an artificial intelligence focus.
courses.academic_requirements: A 2.2 Honours degree or higher, or equivalent, in any discipline except computer science or a similar computing degree. Applicants without a degree may be considered with recent relevant technical industry experience such as programming.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with no component below 5.5, taken within the last 2 years, or an equivalent qualification. The university's comparable scores for this level are PTE Academic 64 (59 in each component) and Duolingo 110 (100 in each subscore).
courses.application_deadline_note: No date given; the page advises early application for courses starting in late September because of high demand.
courses.notes: The course page states the fee without naming the year; it matches the 2027/28 laboratory-based postgraduate rate of GBP 29,000 on the international fees page.

scholarships.name: International Office Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 3,500 or GBP 4,000 depending on fee rate, including advanced entry into Year 2 or 3
scholarships.summary: An automatic tuition reduction for new full time international undergraduates at Queen's, awarded on enrolment without a separate application. Some exclusions apply.
scholarships.criteria_text: New full time undergraduate students paying the international fee; no academic criteria stated; exclusions apply.
scholarships.notes: Listed on the 2026/27 Pakistan scholarships page; no 2027/28 terms found. First year only is not stated either way.

scholarships.name: International Office Postgraduate Taught Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 2,000 to GBP 5,000 off tuition, awarded on enrolment
scholarships.summary: An automatic tuition reduction for new full time international taught postgraduates, excluding Queen's Business School taught programmes, awarded on enrolment without a separate application.
scholarships.criteria_text: New full time postgraduate taught students paying the international fee; excludes Queen's Business School taught programmes; no academic criteria stated.
scholarships.notes: Listed on the 2026/27 Pakistan scholarships page; no 2027/28 terms found. The page does not say what decides the amount within the range.

scholarships.name: Early Confirmation Award
scholarships.value_text: GBP 1,500 reduction in Year 1 tuition fees
scholarships.summary: A first-year tuition reduction for new full time international students with an unconditional offer who pay their fees in full by the published deadline. There is no form; proof of payment is emailed to the scholarships team.
scholarships.criteria_text: New full time students with an unconditional offer who pay fees in full by the deadline.
scholarships.deadline_note: 2026/27 deadline was 18 September 2026 for undergraduate and taught postgraduate students; research students pay before the start date in the offer letter. The 2027/28 date is not yet published.
scholarships.notes: The page contains a stray reference to January 2026 that conflicts with the September 2026 deadline; the September date was used. Application route is an emailed proof of payment, recorded as separate_application.

scholarships.name: Vice Chancellor's International Attainment Scholarship (Undergraduate)
scholarships.value_text: 50% of tuition fees for up to four years; four awards
scholarships.summary: A competitive award of half of tuition fees for new international undergraduates on a listed full time programme who hold an offer and have made Queen's their firm UCAS choice. Applicants submit a video and an online application.
scholarships.criteria_text: New international undergraduate on a listed full time programme (about 20 BSc, BEng, BA and LLB programmes); offer held; Queen's as UCAS firm choice.
scholarships.deadline_note: 2026 round closed 4 June 2026 at 15:00 BST; the 2027 date is not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Terms are the 2026 round as listed on the Pakistan scholarships and South Asia pages; 2027 terms not found.

scholarships.name: Vice Chancellor's International Attainment Scholarship (Postgraduate Taught)
scholarships.value_text: 50% of tuition fees for up to two years; four awards
scholarships.summary: A competitive award of half of tuition fees for new international taught postgraduates on one of about 35 listed full time programmes. Applicants submit a video and an online application.
scholarships.criteria_text: New international postgraduate taught student on a listed full time programme (about 35 listed); offer held.
scholarships.deadline_note: 2026 round closed 7 May 2026 at 15:00 BST; the 2027 date is not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Terms are the 2026 round as listed on the Pakistan scholarships and South Asia pages; the list of eligible programmes was not opened, so check that a chosen course is on it.

scholarships.name: Pakistan Academic Excellence Award
scholarships.value_text: GBP 7,500 towards Year 1 tuition; five awards
scholarships.summary: A Year 1 tuition award for undergraduates from Pakistani secondary schools who are predicted AAB at A level or 34 IB points and apply online with an essay of up to 750 words. Awards depend on achieving the predicted grades.
scholarships.criteria_text: At, or previously at, a secondary school in Pakistan; starting full time undergraduate study; predicted AAB at A level or 34 IB points including 6,6,5 at Higher Level; essay of up to 750 words.
scholarships.deadline_note: 2026 round closed 17 July 2026 at 15:00 BST; the 2027 date is not yet published.
scholarships.notes: The page is titled Pakistan Academic Excellence Award 2026; a 2027 edition is not yet published. Exclusions apply but were not listed.

scholarships.name: Queen's Family Scholarship
scholarships.summary: A first-year tuition reduction for children, grandchildren or siblings of Queen's alumni or current students. Step relatives may also be eligible, and the relationship may need to be verified. Applicants use a form linked from the page.
scholarships.criteria_text: Child, grandchild or sibling of a Queen's alumnus or current student; stepchildren and step-siblings may also be eligible.
scholarships.notes: Listed on the 2026/27 Pakistan scholarships page; the linked form and full terms were not opened.

GREAT Scholarship: listed for India and Malaysia only.
